cohort: 3095 women with singleton pregnancies and macrosomic newborns (>4000g) at term (37-41 weeks gestation)
finding: Induction of labor at 37-41 weeks gestation in women with macrosomic newborns did not reduce cesarean section rates or increase vaginal delivery rates compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: This study compared induction of labor with expectant management in women with macrosomic fetuses.
